title: manotes palisotii
intro: Manotes palisotii, commonly known as African Pear, is a species of flowering plant in the family Sapindaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Manotes palisotii include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat respiratory infections.
